subject: Tactical QPS boost request — short window uplift & overrun settlement
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@launchlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Short-term throughput need + question on overrun true-up

Hi Irene,

We hit a traffic spike overnight related to a campaign we're running and are pegged against our current quota. Could Redwood temporarily raise our throughput window (QPS and daily quota) for ~48 hours while we stabilize?

Two quick questions:
- How does Redwood handle short-window overrun true-ups for one-off events? Is there a discounted overrun rate for planned launch windows if we accept a short-term uplift?
- Can you outline the procurement path so we can get legal/PO in front of this quickly? We may need a small amendment rather than a full re-contract.

If possible, we’d like a provisional number for uplift cost and any discount band that applies for a single 48–72 hour window. I can loop in procurement if you need formal docs.

Thanks —
Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Product, LaunchLabs
maya@launchlabs.com

Attachments: none
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@launchlabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-28T11:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Short-term throughput need + question on overrun true-up

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the campaign launch. We can support a short-window uplift; below is a proposal that balances reliability and cost predictability so you don’t get an unexpected invoice. High-level:

- Temporary uplift: +2x current daily quota and a 72-hour QPS ceiling increase (start window on acceptance).
- Overrun handling: we’ll apply an interim overrun rate (list price) but offer a 25% one-off rebate on overrun tokens tied to this planned uplift if LaunchLabs signs an amendment (SOW) within 7 days. The rebate only applies to the uplift window overrun, not to new baseline usage.
- Billing/PO path: we’ll draft a short amendment (SOW) that captures uplift window, rebate terms, and final invoicing cadence. Once signed, we’ll activate the uplift.

I attached a provisional pricing calc with two scenarios (conservative and aggressive). Please review and let us know if procurement wants the SOW in Word or DocuSign-ready PDF; Ben can fast-track legal review.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm uplift start time and window (48 vs 72 hours).
2) Procurement sends contact/PO details so we can prepare SOW.
3) We provisionally reserve the burst capacity on our side.

I’ll hold the uplift slot pending your confirmation.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing_calc.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya@launchlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-29T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Short-term throughput need + question on overrun true-up

On Wed, Aug 28, 2028 at 11:00 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> I attached a provisional pricing calc with two scenarios (conservative and aggressive).
>
Thanks — quick technical note from my side: rather than a permanent quota change, we can gate this as a rate-limit upgrade and assign the launch a reserved burst pool for the 72-hour window. That reduces risk to both sides and is quicker to enable from an infra perspective.

Operationally we’ll:
- Provision a burst pool and set a per-minute throttle ceiling for the uplift window.
- Enable KV cache warm-up for your most common prefixes to reduce per-token cost.

If Procurement needs an operational runbook, I can attach the short devops checklist (no PII). Also, final SOW can be DocuSign-ready; include a PO number and we’ll hand the DocuSign link to legal.

Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Related doc: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/burst-pools (internal runbook)
From: procurement@launchlabs.com
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-02T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Short-term throughput need + question on overrun true-up

Irene / Karthik —

Thanks for the clear proposal. LaunchLabs confirms acceptance of the 72-hour uplift (start 2028-09-03T00:00:00Z). We agree to the 25% one-off rebate on overrun tokens tied specifically to the uplift window, subject to a signed amendment.

Attached is our signed PO (LaunchLabs_PO_3742.pdf) and our legal has confirmed the PO references the DocuSign amendment you’ll send. Please:
- Send the DocuSign-ready SOW and we’ll execute it today.
- Activate the burst pool at the start time above.

Deal id: HL-4729 (HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HL-4729).

Thanks —
LaunchLabs Procurement
